definition: παρα-βολεύομαι = cl. παραβάλλομαι (2Ma.14:38),  to expose oneself to danger, hazard one's life: with dative ref., τ. ψυχῇ (see M, Pr., 64), Php.2:30 (Rec. παραβουλ-). Cited by Deiss., LAE, 84, 120.† παρα-βουλεύομαι,  to consult amiss, or perh. (see LS, see word), a vulg. form of παρα-βολ- (which see) : Php.2:30, Rec.† (AS)
